plan: This is a second-price auction where bidding your true value is the dominant strategy. Since I pay the second-highest bid if I win (not my own bid), there's no benefit to shading my bid up or down. Bidding exactly my value of $34 ensures I win whenever the item is worth more to me than the price I'd pay, and I never overpay since I only pay the second-highest bid when I win. This maximizes my expected profit.

The dominant strategy in this format is to bid exactly my true value, since bidding higher risks paying more than the item is worth if someone bids between my value and my bid, while bidding lower only risks losing profitable opportunities without any benefit.
